text: Case study verified against OmicSage config/runs/kuppe_heart.yaml, run_spatial_pipeline.py, saved reports/kuppe_heart and data/processed/kuppe_heart/01–07 checkpoints. Source: Kuppe et al., Spatial multi-omic map of human myocardial infarction, Nature 608, 766–777 (2022), https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-022-05060-x. Only the published control subset was used here: Visium https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/Kuppe_Visium_Human_Heart_2022_Control/22132958 (file 39347357) and snRNA reference file 39347573. Spatial donors P1, P17, P7 and P8. This is a workflow implementation/benchmark, not a reproduction of the full myocardial-infarction disease analysis or spatial HCC analysis. QC counts 500–100000 and genes 200–10000; 19 spots removed, 11706 kept. No MT- feature symbols exist in ingested data and QC records zero matched mitochondrial genes: 20% cutoff did not provide an effective mitochondrial quality screen. Normalization to 10000 + log1p; 3000 Seurat-flavour HVGs; 50 PCs; expression KNN 15 neighbours/30 PCs; Leiden 0.5 yields five unannotated expression clusters. Expression clustering and spatial neighbour graphs are separate. Saved spatial_connectivities has 61021 stored adjacency entries, of which 49893 cross patient_region_id (81.76%), in both latest reduction and older downstream checkpoints; physical adjacency must be block diagonal per tissue section before Moran statistics or adjacency-based inference are interpreted. NNLS actually ran, not cell2location; reference cell_type_original, raw counts layer, 26698 shared genes, normalized coefficients reported as proportions rather than calibrated cell counts. Per_sample=true metadata is misleading for NNLS: implementation uses pooled reference signatures and solves each spot; only the cell2location branch implements a per-library fit loop. Adipocyte, Cycling cells and Fibroblast receive zero weights throughout; Endothelial mean 0.5695, Cardiomyocyte 0.3371, Lymphoid 0.0867. These are fitted coefficients, not established tissue composition. Zero/constant abundance and absolute-correlation ranking make some downstream marker lists unreliable. Tangram clusters mode projects 2000 genes; report rho=0.292 compares means for 50 overlapping genes, not held-out spatial prediction; no per-spot mapping score is available, so zero poor-score spots cannot establish success. Moran report lists 102/3000 FDR<0.05; composition clustering lists 49 regions; GO prerank ranks Moran I, not differential expression, with one q<0.05 among 1004 pathways. Do not call a negative NES pathway biologically downregulated. Ligand-receptor analysis was sq.gr.ligrec, seed42, 1000 permutations, expression-group test by dominant_cell_type; its call does not use spatial adjacency or an explicit colocalisation filter. Raw-p counts 8356 <0.001 and 21452 <0.05 are not FDR-validated spatial communication. Co-occurrence pools coordinates across sections; repeat per section. June16 ingest/reduce/cluster checkpoints coexist with June11–12 upstream provenance in deconvolve/downstream/impute: existing runner cache uses existence rather than input fingerprints. Rebuild graph per patient_region_id, invalidate descendants, validate signatures and marker sign/variance, use held-out gene validation, then interpret results. Future applications to liver niches are transferable questions, not completed analyses. Full audit: docs/interview_preparation/OMICSAGE_SPATIAL_CASE_STUDY_AUDIT.md.
